name: image-js
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Pure-JS image analysis and processing; duplicates sharp and jimp
summary: Pure TypeScript image processing library for Node and the browser: load, grayscale, threshold, morphology, ROI detection and pixel ops on typed arrays. Aimed at scientific image analysis rather than production asset prep. Distinguishing strength: ROI and mask analysis in JS; otherwise overlaps sharp and jimp.
use_when: Mask or region analysis (ROI, morphology) in JS without native deps
avoid_when: Resize, convert, composite: sharp is faster and native
Pure-JS fallback with no native build: jimp

assessment.rationale: Maintained (1.7.1 Sep 2026, Zakodium) but duplicates sharp (faster, native) and jimp (pure JS) for resize, crop and filters; its analysis tools (ROI, morphology) are not a VCR need. Choose sharp or jimp.
